title: Tesaa
tagline: Lightweight point-of-sale and inventory app for small shop owners.
overview: Tesaa is a simple point-of-sale and inventory tool built for small shop owners who needed something faster to set up than full retail management software.
problem: Small shop owners were tracking sales and stock manually, making it hard to know what was actually selling or when to restock.
solution: A focused Flutter app covering quick sale entry, stock level tracking, and basic daily sales totals, with none of the overhead of enterprise POS systems.
architecture: Flutter app with local persistence for products, stock levels, and sale records, built for fast entry during busy shop hours.
features: Quick sale entry with running totals
challenges: Keeping the sale-entry flow fast enough for real use during busy periods, not just usable in a demo
lessonsLearned: For daily-use business tools, speed of the core action (in this case, recording a sale) matters more than the breadth of features
futureImprovements: Barcode scanning for faster product lookup
Multi-device sync for shops with more than one till
results: Gave a small shop owner a faster, clearer way to track sales and stock
